subject: maths
question: Two cylinders have the radii of their bases in the ratio 4 : 5 and their heights are in the ratio 5 : 7. Find the ratio of their curved surface areas.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The curved surface area (CSA) of a cylinder is directly proportional to the product of its radius and height.

Ratio of CSA = (r₁ × h₁) : (r₂ × h₂)

Ratio = (4 × 5) : (5 × 7)

Ratio = 20 : 35 = 4 : 7

**∴ The correct answer is 4 : 7.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Ratio of radii (r₁ : r₂) = 4 : 5

Ratio of heights (h₁ : h₂) = 5 : 7

**Formula Used:**

Curved Surface Area (CSA) of a cylinder = 2πrh

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bf8d775b35c0a17db0227743ddfcde25a494b35aa4a4dbf3c105d1a035823233.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the radii of the two cylinders be 4x and 5x respectively.

⇒ Let the heights of the two cylinders be 5y and 7y respectively.

⇒ CSA of the first cylinder = 2 × π × 4x × 5y = 40πxy

⇒ CSA of the second cylinder = 2 × π × 5x × 7y = 70πxy

⇒ Ratio of their CSAs = 40πxy ÷ 70πxy

⇒ Ratio = 4 : 7

**∴ The correct answer is 4 : 7.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Total Surface Area of a Cylinder

Includes the curved surface area and the areas of the two circular bases. Formula: 2πr(r + h).

Volume of a Cylinder

The total 3D space enclosed by the cylinder. Formula: πr²h.

Curved Surface Area of a Cone

The surface area of the lateral or curved part of a right circular cone. Formula: πrl, where l is the slant height (l = √(r² + h²)).
